Untimed finite refill, separate records, no seconds penalty

Second hint provides reading kind, kana length and ending; panel glows

limitations: Previous 3 performance/resource suites and continuation/scaling metrics remain bound to build 097461f; they were not rerun for this incremental runtime.
Linux WebKit is not physical iOS Safari.
Reserve cards are still a seeded random stack; graph-conditioned construction applies to the initial 24 panels.
Short games remain possible; opening checks and sampled board quality do not prove all choices continue.
resolvedDiagnostics: Initial refill hint fixture lacked the required reserve stack; corrected fixture.
Virtual 65-second wait now waits for replacement images first, avoiding an artificial image deadline.
Old tests assumed player-first, reserve[0], instant trapped-CPU result and a practice-mode seconds penalty; expectations now follow requested rules.
WebKit host package checks do not recognize workspace libraries; rerun uses existing workspace libraries and software GL configuration, without system installation.
